name: Admin Send Proposal Email (Sent+)
description: The Correos tab is visible from draft onward. Its first card edits and previews the proposal's plain-text personalized send message; drafts may save it empty, although initial send is blocked until completed. After the first send, the same tab also exposes the proposal follow-up composer and immutable email history. Follow-up sends write ProposalChangeLog EMAIL_SENT and update last_activity_at through the proposal-email endpoints.
